title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 with Unprecedented Reasoning Capabilities
excerpt: The latest flagship model demonstrates near-human performance across complex multi-step reasoning tasks, setting new benchmarks in mathematics and coding.
body: OpenAI has officially released GPT-5, its most powerful model to date. The model demonstrates remarkable improvements in chain-of-thought reasoning, coding, and scientific analysis. In internal benchmarks, GPT-5 outperforms previous models by a significant margin on tasks requiring multi-step logical deduction. The release marks a pivotal moment in the development of artificial general intelligence.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: Google DeepMind's AlphaFold 3 Unlocks Protein-Drug Interactions
excerpt: The breakthrough model can now predict how proteins interact with small molecules, dramatically accelerating drug discovery pipelines.
body: Google DeepMind has unveiled AlphaFold 3, a major upgrade that extends beyond protein structure prediction to modeling interactions between proteins and small molecules including drugs, DNA, and RNA. This capability could compress drug discovery timelines from years to months.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: Anthropic's Constitutional AI Gets a Major Upgrade
excerpt: The new framework enables Claude to reason about ethical dilemmas with greater nuance and consistency across diverse cultural contexts.
body: Anthropic has published research on a significantly enhanced version of Constitutional AI. The updated approach incorporates multi-perspective moral reasoning and shows improved resistance to jailbreaks while maintaining helpfulness.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas 2.0 with Full-Body AI Control
excerpt: The humanoid robot now uses end-to-end neural networks for locomotion and manipulation, eliminating hand-crafted control systems.
body: Boston Dynamics has demonstrated Atlas 2.0, featuring a complete overhaul of its control architecture. The robot now uses a single neural network trained via reinforcement learning to control all joints simultaneously.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: What Companies Need to Know
excerpt: The world's first comprehensive AI regulation framework enters its enforcement phase, with fines up to 6% of global revenue.
body: The European Union's AI Act has entered its first major enforcement phase. Companies deploying AI systems classified as high-risk must now comply with strict transparency, documentation, and testing requirements.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs Ship to Data Centers Globally
excerpt: The next-generation AI accelerator delivers 4x the performance of H100 with improved energy efficiency for large-scale model training.
body: NVIDIA has begun mass shipments of its Blackwell B200 GPUs to hyperscale data centers. Early benchmarks show 4x improvement in AI training throughput compared to the H100, while energy consumption per FLOP improves by 40%.
author: MaqaalTech Staff
